changed: PATCH 0.41.4 changes only the homepage MediaCard resource-selection lifecycle. The approved same-origin film is assigned to the connected native video element and explicitly loaded after mount, rather than selecting a dynamically mutated child source in an imported empty video template. Source updates reselect only when the raw source actually changes.

Native controls, inline playback, metadata preloading, retained poster, optional English captions, synchronous user-initiated CTA/retry and the original CDN fallback remain. There is no autoplay. Replaced-source and unmount transitions invalidate older play promises; unmount pauses and clears the resource so detached media does not continue playing.

Historical native evidence at DEV 0.41.3/main 668c40bb7b2d3be354bbc4250ab6f3b3aaa2d514: the user's iPhone Safari decoded both plain diagnostic players and paused around five seconds of the 120-second film, while the homepage still did not play. The user's separate request returned 206, video/mp4, Content-Range bytes 0-1/20195565, Content-Length 2 and two body bytes. That separate fetch is not native-media proof. The diagnostic success narrows the remaining issue to homepage integration or its extras; it does not conclusively identify the failing lifecycle step.

Local affected checks passed 49 tests across four component/lifecycle suites, plus one source-wiring test, normal Next build and typecheck. New checks assert connected-node selection, no reload for unrelated props/native playing, source-change validation, stale-promise isolation, current native-error reporting and unmount cleanup. Native load/play/pause are mocked in these tests; no native Safari success is inferred. An initial expanded run exposed one stale child-source selector in an existing fixture (48 passed, one failed), corrected before the passing rerun.

Fixed affected persona/scenario denominator 3: phone visitor starts the overview with native controls; desktop visitor uses the watch CTA; visitor retries or leaves/replaces the player. Local automated layer attempted 3, passed 3, failed 0, untested 0, with mocked media APIs. Current candidate DEV-browser and physical-iPhone layers each attempted 0, passed 0, failed 0, untested 3. Historical plain-player diagnostic success is not current homepage acceptance. Production is not targeted. Human satisfaction, confusion and frustration are NOT MEASURED; sample 0.

This is a DEV-only compatibility candidate, not a claim that Safari playback is fixed. Actual native homepage testing is still required before production. All 133 older release entries and accepted notes remain intact; unrelated frozen work is excluded.
security: Each actual source update retains HTTPS or strict same-origin path validation before native assignment. No arbitrary HTML, telemetry, credential reads, authentication/session changes, backend/media-route changes, approved media changes, schema, bindings, security settings or deployment trigger changes. Existing bounded failure diagnostics never expose exception messages, tokens or request URLs.
